forbidden.title: You are not allowed to do that

conflict.title: Somebody else changed this in the meantime

localized.missing: Fill this field in for every language of the division.

url.absolute: Enter a full address starting with http:// or https://

number.min: Enter a number that is not smaller than the minimum.

locale.unsupported: The division does not publish in that language.

slug.invalid: Use lower case letters, digits and single dashes.

body.notAnObject: This page has no content yet.
body.tooLarge: This page is too large to save. Move some of it to a page of its own.
body.schemaVersion: This page was written by a newer version of the hub.
body.tooDeep: Sections cannot be nested any deeper than this.
body.idMissing: This section or block has lost its identifier.
body.idDuplicated: Two sections or blocks share one identifier.
body.blockTypeMissing: This block does not say what it is.
body.blockTypeUnknown: This block is of a type the hub does not know.
body.templateOnlyKey: Only a template may fix this. Change it on the template instead.
body.layoutUnknown: This section asks for a layout that does not exist.
body.renderModeUnknown: This block asks to be drawn in a way that does not exist.
body.columnOutOfRange: This block is in a column its section does not have.

content.templateNotPublishable: A template is not published: make a page from it and publish that.
